correctness.rationale: Checked RESULT.md at the exact frozen blob 762aeddf8c4da73a0857f3b2e88c5f262f153731. Expanding the four shifted products gives n(y-x)(w-z); the gap between distinct integer kth powers is at least kV^(k-1), proving yw>k^k(xz)^(k-1)/n^k. With x=a1*a5*X, y=a2*a5*X, z=a3, w=a4, strict ordered-element comparisons give X<k^(-k/(k-2))*n^(k/(k-2)). The empty subset forces n+1=q^k and each a_i (i>=2)>k*n^((k-1)/k). For tail r=d-5, r(k-1)/k>=k/(k-2) holds at r=3 for k=4,5, at r=2 for k>=6, with positive constants already giving strict contradiction. Independently verified the identity and boundary exponent inequalities. No claim of optimal dimensions or negative shifts.
